name: chapter_7
title: Introduction to Comparatives and Superlatives
description: This chapter explains how to use comparative and superlative adjectives to compare people, places, and things.

questions.question: Which is the correct comparative form?

options.A: She is more taller than her brother.
options.B: She is tallest than her brother.
options.C: She is taller than her brother.
options.D: She is most tall than her brother.

questions.question: Which is the correct superlative form?

options.A: This is the most beautiful painting.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a comparative adjective correctly?

options.C: Today is more cold than yesterday.
options.D: Today is most cold than yesterday.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a superlative adjective correctly?

options.A: Mount Everest is the higher mountain in the world.
options.B: Mount Everest is the most high mountain in the world.
options.C: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
options.D: Mount Everest is higher mountain in the world.
